English: We determined serum biochemical (AST, ALT, ALP, serum ALB), histopathological (gill, lungs), serum antioxidant enzyme responses (SOD, CAT, GPx, GR, GST) which serves as a biomarker for evaluating oxidative stress while micronucleus and comet assays were used to detect level of DNA damage in Tilapia zillii and Clarias gariepinus.
Luganda: Twazuula enkalira z’ebirungo by’olusaayisaayi (AST, ALT, ALP, ALB), obutaffaali obulwadde (endaka, amawuggwe), enneeyisa ya enzayimu ezikuuma obutaffaali obutafuna buvune (SOD, CAT, GPx, GR, GST) ebikola ng’enkalira eyeesigamwako okwekaliriza omuziziko gw’omukka gwa oxygen olwo ebitundu by’obutaffaali ebyayonooneka n’olutiba olukozesebwa okwekaliriza okwonooneka kwa DNA mu byennyanja ebimanyiddwa nga Tilapia zillii awamu ne Clarias gariepinus.
Yoruba: A ṣẹ̀dá sìrọ́ọ̀mù baokẹ́míkà(AST, ALT, ALP, sìrọ́ọ̀mù ALB) ṣiṣẹ́ ìwádìí tíṣù/ẹ̀yà ará (ẹ̀rẹ̀kẹ́ ẹja, ẹ̀dọ̀fóró) sìrọ́ọ̀mù adéèmídúró àbájáde ẹ́nsáìmù (SOD, CAT, GPx, GR, GST) tí èyí jẹ́ ṣiṣẹ́ bí ohun tí ó mú ohun tí ó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ nínú sẹ́ẹ̀lì fún ṣíṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò àìdúródédé pípèsè àti àkójọpọ̀ atẹ́gùn nínú sẹ́ẹ̀lì tí núkílọ̀sì kéékèèké àti ọ̀nà tí a fí ń wọn DNA láti fọ́ sẹ́ẹ̀lì tí wọ́n ń lò láti mọ ipele tí DNA ti bàjẹ́ nínú ẹja epìyà onínú Pupa àti ẹja àrò eléyín mímú.
Zulu: Sinqume i-serum biochemical (AST, ALT, ALP, serum ALB), histopathological (gill, lungs), impendulo ye-serum antioxidant enzyme (SOD, CAT, GPx, GR, GST) esebenza njenge-biomarker yokuhlola ingcindezi ye-oxidative ngenkathi i-micronucleus nenkanyezi enomsila. ama-assay asetshenziswa ukuthola izinga lomonakalo we-DNA e-Tilapia zillii kanye no-Clarias gariepinus.
Hausa: Mun ƙaddara sinadarin halitta (AST, ALT, ALP, serum ALB), na cututtukan ƙyallayen jiki (manumfasar kifi da huhu), maganin antioxidant sinadarin enzyme (SOD, CAT, GPx, GR, GST) wanda yake aiki a matsayin mai alamar halitta don kimanta damuwa na oxidative yayin da micronucleus da comet.An yi amfani da gwaje-gwaje don gano matakin lalacewar DNA a Tilapia zillii da Clarias gariepinus.
Northern Sotho: Re hweditše seramo ya payokhemikhale (AST, ALT, ALP, seramo ya ALB), histopatholotšikhale (dikili, maswafo), diphetolo tša diensaeme go seramo ya anthioksitente (SOD, CAT, GPx, GR, GST) yeo e šomago bjalo ka payomeikha go sekaseka kgatelelo ya oksitetibi mola e le gore dinyutleleara tše nnyane le dikhomete di ile tša šomišwa go utolla maemo a tshenyo ya Tilapia zillii le Clarias gariepinus.

English: Our results showed significant increase in biochemical and hematological profiles, histopathological lesions in the gill and lungs, inductions of MN, NA and DNA single strand break in Tilapia zillii and Clarias gariepinus collected from Asa rivers compared to the Unilorin, Apodun and Asa reservoirs.

English: Pollution in rivers and dams is usually caused by waste from farms, factories, and peoples’ homes that is dumped into the water.
Luganda: Okwonoona amazzi mu migga n’amabibiro g’amazzi kutera kuva ku bisigalira ebiyiibwa mu mazzi okuva mu ffaamu, amakolero ne mu maka g’abantu.
Yoruba: Ìdọ̀tí inú Odò àti ìsedò máa ń ṣẹlẹ̀ látara ẹ̀gbin inú ọkọ, ilẹ̀-iṣẹ́ àti ilé àwọn èèyàn ti wọ́n ju nǹkan sí inú omi.
Zulu: Ukungcola emifuleni nasemadamini ngokuvamile kubangelwa imfucumfucu evela emapulazini, ezimbonini, nasezindlini zabantu echithwa emanzini.

Northern Sotho: Tšhilafatšo ka meetseng le ka matamong ka tlwaelo e bakwa ke ditšhila go tšwa ka dipolaseng, ka difemeng, le ka magaeng a batho tšeo di lahlelwago ka meetseng.

English: This pollution can harm people and animals that need these water sources to survive.
Luganda: Okwonoona amazzi kuno kusobola okukosa abantu awamu n’ensolo ezeetaaga amazzi gano okubeerawo.

English: To measure the effects of water pollution, scientists often look at changes in sensitive species, like fish, because their bodies usually respond quickly to bad water quality, and the changes are easy to see.
Luganda: Okusobola okupima ebiva mu kwonoona amazzi, bannassaayansi batera okutunuulira enkyukakyuka mu bitonde ebiri mu katyabaga, gamba ng’ebyennyanja, kubanga emibiri gyabyo gitera okukosebwa amangu amazzi amabi, ate ng’enkyukakyuka nnyangu za kulaba.

Zulu: Ukuze balinganise imiphumela yokungcoliswa kwamanzi, ososayensi bavame ukubheka izinguquko ezinhlobonhlobo ezibucayi, njengezinhlanzi, ngoba imizimba yabo ivame ukusabela ngokushesha eqophelweni elibi lamanzi, futhi izinguquko zibonakala kalula.

English: The researchers caught the fish from 5 sites in the area, including 3 dams and 2 sections of the Asa River.

English: For each site, they tested the water quality to understand the chemicals and the amount of oxygen in the water.

Yoruba: Ṣí ojúlé kọ̀ọ̀kan, Wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò sí bí omi náà ṣe dáa tó láti fi ní òye kíkún nípa àwọn kẹ́míkà àti ìyè atẹ́gùn tí ó wà nínú omi.

Northern Sotho: Go lefelo le lengwe le le lengwe, ba ile ba dira diteko tša boleng bja meetse go kwešiša dikhemikhale le tekano ya oksitšene ya ka meetseng.

English: In the laboratory, they looked for any signs of damage to cells and DNA in fish blood samples.

Hausa: Sun kuma bincika ko akwai wasu canje-canje ga matakan sinadaran furotin, wanda ake kira sinadaran enzymes, a cikin jini.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lekola gape go bona ge eba go na le diphetogo dife goba dife goi maemo a diphrotheine tše di kgethegilego, tše di bitšwago diensaeme, ka mading.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በደም ውስጥ ኢንዛይሞች በሚባሉ በተለዩ ፕሮቲኖች ላይ የሆነ አይነት ለውጥ ተከስቶ እንደነበር ፈትሸዋል።

English: By looking for higher levels of certain enzymes, the researchers could tell whether the fish had suffered stress from pollution.
Luganda: Mu kunoonya obungi obwa waggulu obwa enzayimu ezimu, abanoonyereza baali basobola okulaba oba ng’ebyennyanja byali bikoseddwa okwonooneka kw’amazzi.
Yoruba: Nípa wíwá ipele ẹ́nsàímù tí ó ga, àwọn aṣèwádìí lè sọ bóyá ẹja náà tí jẹ̀yà látàrí ìdọ̀tí náà.
Zulu: Ngokubheka amazinga aphezulu ama-enzyme athile, abacwaningi bangasho ukuthi inhlanzi ike yahlushwa yini ingcindezi ngenxa yokungcola.
Hausa: Ta hanyar neman mafi girma matakan wasu sinadaran enzymes, masu bincike za su iya faɗar ko kifi ya sha wahala daga gurɓacewa.
Northern Sotho: Ge ba nyaka maemo a godingwana a diensaeme tše itšego, banyakišiši ba be ba kgona go bona gore hlapi e ile ya ba le kgatelelo ka lebaka la tšhilafatšo.
Amharic: የተወሰኑ ኢንዛይሞችን በከፍተኛ ደረጃ መከሰት በማየት ተመራማሪዎቹ አሳው በብክለት ምክንያት ውጥረት ደርሶበት እንደነበረ መናገር ይችላሉ።

English: Finally, they dissected (cut open) the fish to check for any signs of damage to their organs.
Luganda: Ekisembayo, baabaaga ekyennyanja okuzuula obubonero bwonna obwoleka okwonooneka kw’ebitundu byabyo eby’omunda.
Yoruba: Ní ìgbẹ̀yìn, Wọ́n gé ẹja náà láti wọ̀ bóyá wọ́n lè rí àmì ibi tí ó tí ń bàjẹ́ nínú ẹ̀yà ara wọn.
Zulu: Ekugcineni, bahlinza (basika bavule) inhlanzi ukuze bahlole izimpawu zokulimala kwezitho zabo.
Hausa: Daga ƙarshe dai sun yanyanke (yanke) kifin domin a duba ko akwai alamun lalacewar sassan jikinsu.
Northern Sotho: Mafelelong, ba ile ba aroganya (ba bula) hlapi go lekola masweo afe goba afe a tshenyo ya ditho tša yona.
Amharic: በመጨረሻ የጉዳት ምልክትች እንዳሉ ለመፈተሽ አሳውን በታትነውት (ቀደው ከፍተው) ነበር።

English: The researchers found that fish caught in the Asa River showed more signs of being damaged by pollution than those in the dams.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula ng’ebyennyanja ebyavubibwa mu mugga Asa byayoleka obubonero bungi obulaga nti byakosebwa okwonooneka kw’amazzi okusinga ku ebyo eby’omu mabibiro g’amazzi.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí fi ye àwọn aṣèwádìí pé àwọn ẹja tí wọ́n mú nínú Odò Asa fi ń hàn wọ́n pé kí wọ́n ṣe àkíyèsí pé ìdọ̀tí tí ń bá àwọn ẹja náà jẹ́ jù tí èyí tí ó wà nínú ìsedò lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi izinhlanzi ezidotshwe emfuleni i-Asa zikhombisa izimpawu eziningi zokulimala ngenxa yokungcola kunalezo ezisemadamini.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa kifin da aka kama a kogin Asa ya nuna alamun lalacewa ta hanyar gurɓatar yanayi fiye da waɗanda ke cikin madatsun ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba hwetša gore dihlapi tšeo di swerwego ka Nokeng ya Asa di laeditše maswao a mantši a tshenyo ka lebaka la tšhilafalo go feta tšeo di lego ka matamong.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳገኙት በአሳ ወንዝ ውስጥ የተጠመዱ አሳዎች ከግድቦች ይልቅ በብክለት ምክንያት ብዙ ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው ብዙ ምልክቶችን አሳይተዋል።

English: In many cases, for example, these fish had damage to their gills and livers.
Luganda: Okugeza, kyeyoleka nnyo nti ebyennyanja bino byalina obukosefu ku ndaka zaabyo n’ebibumba.
Yoruba: Ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìgbà, fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn ẹja yìí tí ń bàjẹ́ ní ẹ̀rẹ̀kẹ́-ẹja àt ẹdọ̀ wọn.
Zulu: Ezimweni eziningi, ngokwesibonelo, lezi zinhlanzi zaba nomonakalo emankankeni nasezibindini kwazo.
Hausa: A lokuta da yawa, alal misali, waɗannan kifayen sun sami lahani ga manumfasar kifi da kuma hanta.
Northern Sotho: Mabakeng a mantši, go fa mohlala, dihlapi tše di bile le tshenyo go dikili le go dibete tša tšona.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ በአብዛኛዎቹ ኬዞች እነዚህ አሳዎች ጊላቸው እና ጉበታቸው ላይ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ነበር።

English: They added that fish from the middle of the river, where a lot of pollution enters the water, also had the most damage to their DNA.
Luganda: Baayongerako ne bagamba nti ebyennyanja okuva mu masekkati g’ennyanja, obucaafu obungi we buyingirira mu mazzi, era bye byasinga okuba n’obukosefu mu ndagabutonde zaabyo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe àfikún pé kí ẹja láti inú àárín odò,níbi tí ìdọ̀tí bá wọ inú omi náà, bẹ́ẹ̀ lo ń ṣe ìjàmbá fún DNA wọn.
Zulu: Bangezelele bathi izinhlanzi ezisuka phakathi komfula, lapho ukungcola okuningi kungena khona emanzini, nazo zinomonakalo omkhulu kuDNA yazo.
Hausa: Sun kuma ƙara da cewa kifayen da ke tsakiyar kogin, inda gurɓataccen ruwa yake shiga ruwa, shi ma ya fi illa ga DNA ɗinsu.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba tlaleletša ka gore dihlapi go tšwa ka bogareng bja noka, fao tšhilafatšo ye ntši e tsenago gona ka meetseng, le tšona di bile le tshenyo ye ntši go DNA ya tšona.
Amharic: አክለው እንደተናገሩት ብዙ ብክለት ወደውሃው በሚገባበት ወንዝ መካከል የተያዙ አሳዎች በተጨማሪ ዲኤኔያቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።

English: River fish also had higher levels of enzymes in their blood than those caught in the dams.
Luganda: Ebyennyanja by’omu mugga era byalina enzayimu za waggulu mu musaayi gwabyo okusinga ebyo ebyavubibwa mu mabibiro g’amazzi.
Yoruba: Ẹja odò náà ní ẹ́nsàímù tí ó ga jù nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀ wọn ju èyí tí a mú nínú ìsedò lọ.
Zulu: Izinhlanzi zasemfuleni nazo zazinamazinga aphezulu ama-enzyme egazini lawo kunalawo abanjwe emadamini.
Hausa: Kifin kogin kuma yana da matakan sinadaran enzymes mafi girma a cikin jininsu fiye da waɗanda aka kama a cikin madatsun ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Dihlapi tša ka dinokeng di bile le maemo a godimodimo a diensaeme ka mading a tšona go feta tšeo di swerwego ka matamong.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ የወንዝ አሳዎች ከግድቦች ከተያዙት ይልቅ በደማቸው ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ኢንዛይሞች ነበሯቸው።

English: The researchers said that these high enzyme levels could indicate that the fish were stressed by the low amount of oxygen they found when they tested the river water.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti obungi bwa enzayimu buno bwandyoleka nti ebyennyanja byali bikosebwa embeera y’okuba n’omukka gwa oxygen omutono gye baazuula nga bakebera amazzi g’omugga.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn ẹ́nsàímù nínú ìpele tó ga lè fi hàn pé ẹja náà ṣe wàhálà látàrí iye atẹ́gùn tó gbà kéré nígbà tí wọ́n rí tí wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò omi odò náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi la mazinga aphezulu e-enzyme angabonisa ukuthi izinhlanzi zazigcizelelwe inani eliphansi le-oxygen elitholile lapho zihlola amanzi omfula.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce waɗannan matakan sinadarin enzyme masu yawa suna iya nuna cewa kifin ya damu da ƙarancin iskar shaƙa da suka samu lokacin da suka gwada ruwan kogin.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore maemo a a godimo a diensaeme a ka laetša gore dihlapi di be di le ka fase ga kgatelelo ka lebaka la tekano ya fase ya oksitšene yeo ba e hweditšego ge ba be ba dira diteko tša meetse a noka.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት እነዚህ ከፍተኛ የኢንዛይም ደረጃዎች አሳዎቹ የወንዝ ውሃውን በመረመሩበት ጊዜ በነበረው በዝቅተኛው የኦክሲጅን መጠን ውጥረት ደርሶባቸው እንደነበር ያሳያል።

English: Low oxygen levels are a sign of pollution, and if people continue to pollute the river, the researchers said that these conditions are likely to get worse.
Luganda: Okuba n’omukka gwa oxygen omutono kabonero akooleka okwonooneka kw’amazzi, era singa abantu bagenda mu maaso n’okwonoona omugga nga bagusuulamu ebintu ebigwonoona, abanoonyereza bagamba nti embeera zino zandisajjuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn atẹ́gùn kékeré jẹ́ àmì tí ìdọ̀tí, àti pe àwọn ènìyàn tú bọ̀ ń dá ìdọ̀tí sì inú Odò náà, àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé ó ní ṣe kó le si.
Zulu: Amazinga omoya aphansi awuphawu lokungcola, futhi uma abantu beqhubeka nokungcolisa umfula, abacwaningi bathi lezi zimo kungenzeka zibe zimbi nakakhulu.
Hausa: Ƙarancin iskar shaƙa alama ce ta gurɓatar yanayi, kuma idan mutane suka ci gaba da gurɓata kogin, masu binciken sun ce waɗannan yanaye-yanaye suna iya munana.
Northern Sotho: Maemo a fase a oksitšene ke taetšo ya tšhilafatšo, gomme ge e le gore batho ba tšwela pele go šilafatša noka yeo, banyakišiši ba boletše gore maemo a go na le kgonagalo ya gore a ka mpefala.
Amharic: አነስተኛ የኦክሲጅን መጠኖች የብክለት ምልክቶቾ ሲሆኑ አንዲሁም ሰዎች ወንዙን መበከል ከቀጠሉ ተመራማሪዎቹ እነዚህ ሁኔታዎች እየተባባሱ ሊሄዱ እንደሚችሉ ይናገራሉ።

English: They recommended that the government should enforce stricter laws to stop people from dumping waste in the future.
Luganda: Baateesa ne bagamba nti gavumenti esaanye eteekese mu nkola amateeka amakakali okusobola okutangira abantu obutayiwa kasasiro mu mazzi mu biseera ebijja.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dábàá pé kí ìjọba ṣe òfin tí ó le láti jẹ́kí àwọn èèyàn má má da ilẹ̀ sí ibi tí kò yẹ ní ọjọ́ iwájú.
Zulu: Baphakamise ukuthi uhulumeni kumele aqinise imithetho eqinile ukuze abantu bangalahla imfucuza ngomuso.
Hausa: Sun bayar da shawarar cewa ya kamata gwamnati ta aiwatar da tsauraran dokoki don hana mutane zubar da shara a nan gaba.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba šišinya gore mmušo o swanetše go diriša melao ye boima ka nepo ya go thibela batho go lahlela ditšhila ka fao meetseng ka moso.
Amharic: ሰዎች ወደፊት ቆሻሻ አንዳይጥሉ መንግስት ጠንከር ያሉ ህጎችን ማስረጽ እንዳለበት መክረዋል።

English: The study was a collaboration between researchers based in Nigeria and the USA.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa omukago gw’abanoonyereza okuva mu ggwanga lya Nigeria ne USA.
Yoruba: Ìṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà jẹ́ ìfọwọ́sọwọ́pọ̀ láàrín aṣèwádìí tí ń gbé ní Nàìjíríà àti èyí tí ó wà ní Àmẹ́ríkà.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana phakathi kwabacwaningi abazinze eNigeria nase-USA.
Hausa: Binciken na haɗin gwiwa ne tsakanin masu bincike da ke Nijeriya da kuma Amurka.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišiši tše e bile tirišano magareng ga banyakišiši bao ba lego ka Nigeria le ka USA.
Amharic: ጥናቱ በናይጄሪያ እና በዩሴኤ በተመሰረቱ ተመራማሪዎች ትብብር የተሰራ ነበር።
